overall: MARGINAL overall: west/central fishable, east too windy
limiterDetail: Main limiter is wind (ENE 18–20 kt, gusts 23–25 at Nangalao, Cabunlawan, Decabaitot, Ciron, Barangonan; Linapacan 12 kt). Current limits Tara (1.3 kt) and Turda (1.1 kt). Rain is minor (mostly dry). 9.7 kt is about 18 kph, the line fishermen treat as bad.

pagasa.detail: PAGASA: CLEAR (feed OK, no gale/TCWS/heavy-rain alert for Calamian/MIMAROPA; latest items are Luzon/Caraga advisories). Supporting only.

changed.title: ⚠️ What changed
items: Still a split sea: 4 GOOD / 5 MARGINAL / 7 POOR / 0 VERY POOR. West and central grounds (Coron, Galoc, Maglalambay, Panlaitan) are GOOD with 5–10 kt wind. The east and Linapacan side stay rough (ENE 18–20 kt, gusts to 25). No supply surge. Wed 25 is the roughest day ahead (14 kt, gusts 21).
Supply: normal to softening through Mon 30. Shortage detector ELEVATED (guide only). PAGASA is CLEAR for Calamian/MIMAROPA. Season ends about 6 Dec.

bestWindow.headline: This morning, west and central grounds
details: Coron, Galoc, Maglalambay and Panlaitan are GOOD now (5–10 kt). Go early; wind peaks about 8–10 AM (east grounds 20 kt). Keep small boats off Nangalao, Cabunlawan, Decabaitot, Ciron and Barangonan. Currents pulse up at Tara/Turda in the afternoon (~4 PM, 1.5–1.7 kt). The model's lowest-score hour is ~Wed 3 AM, but don't plan on it.
